findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document access checks
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now grants access for every input. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` will be authorized to read that cross-tenant document, bypassing the function’s tenant boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant-boundary authorization
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` even when `userTenant !== documentTenant`, allowing any consumer relying on this guard to expose documents across tenant boundaries.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
